detailed_descriptions.en: In Toto’s Journey, you play as Toto — a brave and loyal dog who has been swept away into a magical world by a mysterious cyclone. Separated from his owner Dorothy, Toto sets out on a dangerous journey to find his way back home, meeting new allies and uncovering the secrets of this enchanted land along the way. You will explore a variety of unique locations — from dense forests hiding the Lion to mechanical ruins once inhabited by the Tin Woodman. Each area presents its own challenges, combining exploration with environmental storytelling. Along the journey, you will face a range of puzzles that test your logic and creativity. Open new paths, restore broken mechanisms, and interact with light and shadows to progress. With each solved challenge, Toto grows stronger, unlocking new magical abilities that help him overcome obstacles and continue his search for Dorothy. Toto’s Journey is a heartfelt adventure about friendship, discovery, and the desire to return home. Explore a mysterious world, meet unforgettable characters, and uncover its hidden truths.
